withdraw.title: Withdrawal Request
withdraw.notice: In this demo environment, withdrawals do not transfer real funds. Use this as a business flow blueprint.

items.1: Disbursement account (bank/e-wallet) is verified and under partner owner name.
items.2: Minimum withdrawal amount is met (recommended: >= Rp100,000 per request).
items.3: Available balance is not in pending settlement, dispute, or fraud investigation state.
items.4: No open refunds or active transaction complaints in current withdrawal period.
items.5: Business legal documents and tax data (e.g. NPWP when required) are complete and valid.
items.6: User requesting withdrawal must pass additional auth (PIN/OTP/2FA).

channels.1: Bank transfer (BCA, BNI, BRI, Mandiri, CIMB, Permata) for larger amounts and easier reconciliation.
channels.2: E-wallet (GoPay, OVO, DANA, ShopeePay) for small-mid amounts needing faster disbursement.
channels.3: Regular payout cadence (daily/weekly) is recommended for stable cashflow and controlled admin costs.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Mitra Dewi is committed to protecting your data privacy. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information.

dataCollection.title: Data Collection
dataCollection.content: We collect information you provide when registering, including name, email, phone number, and business information. We also collect usage data to improve our services.

dataUsage.title: Data Usage
dataUsage.content: Your data is used to provide and improve platform services, process transactions, send important notifications, and communicate with you regarding your account.

dataSecurity.title: Data Security
dataSecurity.content: We implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect your personal data from unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.content: Our platform uses cookies to store user preferences and improve browsing experience. You can set cookie preferences through your browser settings.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.content: You have the right to access, update, or delete your personal data at any time. To exercise these rights, please contact our support team through the contact page.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.content: If you have questions about our privacy policy, please contact us at privacy@mitradewi.id or through the contact form on our website.

terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.intro: By using the Mitra Dewi platform, you agree to the following terms and conditions. Please read carefully before using our services.

acceptance.title: Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: By accessing or using the Mitra Dewi platform, you agree to be bound by these terms and conditions. If you do not agree, please do not use this platform.

accounts.title: User Accounts
accounts.content: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account and password. You agree to immediately notify us of any unauthorized use of your account.

partnerObligations.title: Partner Obligations
partnerObligations.content: As a partner, you are responsible for providing accurate information about your products and services, complying with applicable regulations, and maintaining quality standards.

payments.title: Payments and Transactions
payments.content: All transactions through the platform are subject to our payment policy. Revenue sharing will be conducted according to agreements between partners and village tourism managers.

intellectualProperty.title: Intellectual Property
intellectualProperty.content: All content and materials on this platform are copyright protected. You may not copy, modify, or distribute platform content without written permission.

termination.title: Termination
termination.content: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate your account if there is a violation of these terms and conditions, with or without prior notice.

contact.title: Contact
contact.content: For questions regarding terms and conditions, contact us at legal@mitradewi.id.
